title: Examination Under Anaesthesia
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Examine both knees, because the comparison is as important here as anywhere and the unaffected knee is now also fully relaxed.
Record each finding with its grade, its endpoint and its flexion angle, and record explicitly that the examination was under anaesthesia.
Record it before the arthroscopy, because once the joint has been entered the examination has changed.
Say that findings must be labelled as under anaesthesia, because an unlabelled finding will be compared with awake findings later and will mislead.
Where a knee is being operated on for any reason, the examination is free and should be recorded regardless, which is a different proposition from arranging an anaesthetic for it.
- Where a knee is already being anaesthetised the examination is free and should be recorded.
